author: ThioJoe
description:
A major new linux exploit just dropped, and it ain't pretty

A brand new Linux exploit called "Copy Fail" was just publicly released. And while technically it's not a zero-day, it basically is. It was disclosed and patched in the main Linux kernel a month ago, BUT all the major distros didn't even merge it into their main branches. So when it was finally publicly announced, they're now scrambling to patch it in.
